description: This script defines a set of shell-based tests to verify the behavior of the 'git format-patch' command, especially focusing on MIME encoding, signoff functionality, and related headers.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up initial Git repository state by creating a file, adding a commit, modifying the file, and creating a subsequent commit.

methods.name: format normally
methods.description: Tests that the default 'git format-patch' output does not include 'Content-Type' header.

methods.name: format with signoff without funny signer name
methods.description: Verifies that signing off does not introduce 'Content-Type' headers in the patch output.

methods.name: format with non ASCII signer name
methods.description: Checks that when a non-ASCII name is used as the signer, the 'Content-Type' header appears in the output.

methods.name: attach and signoff do not duplicate mime headers
methods.description: Ensures that attaching files and signing off do not result in duplicated MIME headers, specifically checking for 'MIME-Version'.

calls: git commit -m 'This adds some lines to F' F
